<div class="card-body">
'''Millennium Falcon''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ミレニアム・ファルコン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを2名、乗客を2名まで乗せられる。ハン、チューイーかランドが操縦していれば、耐：損耗&lt;5を得る。ドッキング能力を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Millennium-Falcon-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">YT-1300貨物船の改造版。ランド・カルリシアンがサバックの賭で負けて、ハンに譲った。全長26.7メートル。「見てくれは悪いが、中身はすごいんだぜ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Millennium Falcon

'''Card text:''' May carry 2 pilots and up to 2 passengers. If Han, Chewie or Lando is piloting, gains immunity to attrition &lt;5. Has docking capability. Without a pilot, cannot use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

'''Lore:''' A modified YT-1300 freighter. Lando Calrissian lost a sabacc bet and handed it over to Han. Overall length 26.7 meters. "It may look bad, but it's amazing inside!"

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese calls the docking capability ドッキング能力.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Millennium Falcon]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
